summary: Rename duplicates, build the unique index concurrently, attach the constraint.

stages.description: Suffix duplicates, then build the index without blocking writes.
sql: UPDATE account_user SET last_name = last_name || ' #' || id WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM (SELECT id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY last_name ORDER BY id) AS rn FROM account_user) d WHERE rn > 1)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX CONCURRENTLY account_user_last_name_uniq ON account_user (last_name)

stages.description: Deploy the new version; its migration only updates Django state.
Turn the index into a constraint.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ADD CONSTRAINT account_user_last_name_key UNIQUE USING INDEX account_user_last_name_uniq
